mandatoryCriteria: Owner role modification authority: Workspace owner can change any member role (manager, member, viewer) within workspace projects via PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId/members/:userId
Project Manager authority limit: Project Manager can modify member and viewer roles only; attempting to promote to manager or alter a manager role returns 403 FORBIDDEN
Self-protection: Project Manager cannot modify their own role; returns 403 FORBIDDEN
Peer and owner protection: Project Manager cannot modify peer manager roles or workspace owner authority; returns 403 FORBIDDEN
Optimistic Concurrency Control: Requires expectedVersion in payload and rejects stale updates with 409 STALE_VERSION
Sibling project privacy: Outsiders and non-members receive 404 NOT_FOUND
R3 Audit compliance: Role modification serializes with concurrent writes and increments project_memberships version atomically
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId/members/:userId endpoint, role update validations, OCC expectedVersion checks, self and peer protection rules, and version incrementing on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Card assignee reassignment on demotion to viewer is handled under CRD-03.
